recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. If FHIR-54559 is reconciled later, audit it against the now-correct RelatedPerson-role search expression rather than duplicating the source change.
issue_request: FHIR-15841 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for PA. It requested that Patient.contact and RelatedPerson distinguish personal relationship from functional role, use v3-PersonalRelationshipRoleType for personal relationship, use relatedperson-relationshiptype for the new functional role elements, deprecate Patient Contact Relationship, and map Patient.contact.relationship to NK1-3 and Patient.contact.role to NK1-7.
initial_application: Commit 23f3b0abec5678767e3cc7e4b576fdbd3e3b9fb2 initially applied FHIR-15841 by adding Patient.contact.role and RelatedPerson.role, changing relationship bindings, adding examples, and adding a RelatedPerson-role search parameter. Current source still left Patient.contact v2 mappings ambiguous, described Patient.contact.role's binding as a personal relationship, left Patient Contact Relationship as a draft value set, and pointed the RelatedPerson-role search expression at RelatedPerson.relationship.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Patient and RelatedPerson, so the edited StructureDefinitions, resource-local ValueSet, and RelatedPerson search-parameter bundle are in current build scope. FHIR-31670, already audited on the combined branch, supplies the functional-role value-set content including GUARD. FHIR-54559 later confirms the RelatedPerson-role search expression defect, but remains Resolved - change required and was not separately decided in this applied/published seed run.
reconciliation: Published a source-changing commit that maps Patient.contact.relationship to NK1-3, maps Patient.contact.role and RelatedPerson.role to NK1-7, corrects Patient.contact.role's binding description to functional role, marks Patient Contact Relationship deprecated/retired, and changes RelatedPerson-role to search RelatedPerson.role.
